Krusader 2.5.0 brings back a closed window, bundles a diff viewer, and cuts the container's memory use by two thirds. All three come from feedback in the Unraid support thread.

## ✨ Added

- **Kompare is on board.** *File → Compare by Content…* now opens two selected files in a side-by-side diff. Until now that menu entry only answered that Krusader could not find any of the supported diff frontends. Nothing to configure — Krusader finds Kompare on its own and remembers it.

## ⚡ Improved

- **The container idles at about 250 MB instead of 780 MB.** The X server reserves its whole framebuffer up front, roughly four bytes per pixel, no matter how large the browser window is — and the base image sizes that screen at 15360x8640, which is 530 MB of RAM for a resolution nobody uses. The image now caps it at 5120x2880, enough for any 4K or 5K display and any ultrawide.
- **The cap is yours to move.** The new `MAX_RES` variable sits in the Unraid template with a dropdown from 1920x1080 up to 7680x4320. Raise it only if your browser window is genuinely bigger than the cap; above it the picture is scaled to the window rather than cut off.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Quitting Krusader no longer leaves a black screen.** Closing the application in the browser — *File → Quit*, `Ctrl+Q` or the window's X — ended the session and left an empty desktop behind, and only restarting the container brought Krusader back. It now comes back on its own, so a refresh of the browser tab is enough.
- **Shutdown still saves your settings.** The session quits Krusader through its own quit path before the container stops, so window geometry and the status-bar state are written out as before. That path no longer depends on a process ID that a badly timed signal could invalidate.
- **A broken Krusader stops instead of spinning.** If it cannot start at all — five failed starts in a row, or twenty instant exits of any kind — the session gives up and says why, rather than restarting forever and burning CPU.

## 🧹 Removed

- **The Shift-on-function-keys patch is gone, because the base image now fixes it.** v2.4.0 carried a small bridge patch so that Shift+F4 kept its Shift. Upstream solved the same thing one layer up, and more broadly: Shift+Home and Shift+Arrow keep their Shift too. The patch was built to stop the build the day the base caught up, which is exactly what it did.

## 🔍 Under the hood

- `tests/test-krusader-session.sh` runs the real session script against a stub Krusader and pins all of this: restart after a quit, no restart after a container stop, the clean-quit path, and both spin guards. It runs in CI on every push.
